```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6,
                      dpi = 300, out.width = "100%")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())

if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here, knitr, kableExtra, ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, scales, dampack)

suppressMessages(suppressWarnings({
  source(here::here("scripts/R/analysis/02_setup_and_global_variables.R"))
  source(here::here("scripts/R/analysis/03_biomarker_strategies.R"))
  source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/multi_model_cea.R"))
}))

scenario_cache_file <- here::here("data", "tidy",
                                  paste0("scenario_evppi_results_", utility_source_label, ".rds"))
preview_cache_file <- here::here("data", "tidy",
                                 paste0("scenario_evppi_results_", utility_source_label, "_PREVIEW.rds"))

scenario_cache <- NULL
cache_source <- NA_character_
if (file.exists(scenario_cache_file)) {
  scenario_cache <- readRDS(scenario_cache_file)
  cache_source <- basename(scenario_cache_file)
} else if (file.exists(preview_cache_file)) {
  scenario_cache <- readRDS(preview_cache_file)
  cache_source <- basename(preview_cache_file)
}

strategy_label <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(
    x,
    control = "Standard of Care",
    crp = "CRP-guided",
    tmb_braf = "TMB/BRAF-guided",
    .default = x
  )
}

format_eur <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x) | !is.finite(x), "--",
         scales::dollar(x, prefix = "EUR ", accuracy = 1))
}
```

# Overview

This report summarizes scenario EVPPI and PSA outputs for the single joint economic model. The expected cache is `scenario_evppi_results_{utility}.rds`, with a preview cache used as a fallback if available.

# Scenario Definitions

```{r scenario-table}
if (is.null(scenario_cache)) {
  cat("Scenario cache not found. Run scripts/R/analysis/14_scenario_EVPPIs.R or 14b_scenario_preview.R before rendering this report.")
} else {
  scenarios <- scenario_cache$scenarios
  scenario_display <- scenarios %>%
    mutate(
      wtp = format_eur(wtp),
      c_drug_nivo = format_eur(c_drug_nivo)
    )

  knitr::kable(
    scenario_display,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = "l",
    caption = paste0("Scenario definitions loaded from ",
                     gsub("_", "\\\\_", cache_source))
  ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"))
}
```

# PSA Summary by Scenario

```{r scenario-psa}
if (!is.null(scenario_cache)) {
  scenario_rows <- lapply(names(scenario_cache$all_scenario_results), function(id) {
    result <- scenario_cache$all_scenario_results[[id]]
    psa_obj <- result$psa_obj
    info <- result$scenario_info

    if (is.null(psa_obj)) return(NULL)

    cost <- as.matrix(psa_obj$cost)
    effect <- if (!is.null(psa_obj$effect)) as.matrix(psa_obj$effect) else as.matrix(psa_obj$effectiveness)
    nmb <- effect * info$wtp - cost

    data.frame(
      Scenario = info$scenario_name,
      WTP = info$wtp,
      Strategy = psa_obj$strategies,
      Mean_Cost = colMeans(cost, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_QALY = colMeans(effect, na.rm = TRUE),
      Mean_NMB = colMeans(nmb, na.rm = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })

  scenario_psa <- bind_rows(scenario_rows) %>%
    mutate(
      Strategy = strategy_label(Strategy),
      WTP = format_eur(WTP),
      Mean_Cost = format_eur(Mean_Cost),
      Mean_QALY = sprintf("%.3f", Mean_QALY),
      Mean_NMB = format_eur(Mean_NMB)
    )

  knitr::kable(
    scenario_psa,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    col.names = c("Scenario", "WTP", "Strategy", "Mean Cost", "Mean QALYs", "Mean NMB"),
    caption = "PSA summary by scenario"
  ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"))
}
```

# Scenario EVPPI

```{r scenario-evppi}
if (!is.null(scenario_cache) &&
    !is.null(scenario_cache$evppi_all_scenarios) &&
    nrow(scenario_cache$evppi_all_scenarios) > 0) {
  evppi_display <- scenario_cache$evppi_all_scenarios %>%
    group_by(scenario_name, wtp) %>%
    slice_max(evppi, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      WTP = format_eur(wtp),
      EVPPI = format_eur(evppi),
      `Percent of EVPI` = sprintf("%.1f%%", evppi_percent_of_evpi),
      `Population EVPPI` = if ("evppi_population_millions" %in% names(.)) {
        paste0("EUR ", sprintf("%.2f", evppi_population_millions), "M")
      } else {
        "--"
      }
    ) %>%
    select(Scenario = scenario_name, WTP, Parameter = parameter,
           EVPPI, `Percent of EVPI`, `Population EVPPI`)

  knitr::kable(
    evppi_display,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l", "r", "l", "r", "r", "r"),
    caption = "Top EVPPI parameters by scenario"
  ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position", "scale_down"))
} else if (!is.null(scenario_cache)) {
  cat("Scenario cache was found, but no EVPPI rows were available.")
}
```

```{r scenario-evppi-plot, fig.cap="Scenario EVPPI by parameter"}
if (!is.null(scenario_cache) &&
    !is.null(scenario_cache$evppi_all_scenarios) &&
    nrow(scenario_cache$evppi_all_scenarios) > 0) {
  plot_df <- scenario_cache$evppi_all_scenarios %>%
    group_by(scenario_name, parameter) %>%
    summarise(evppi = max(evppi, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = evppi, y = reorder(parameter, evppi), fill = scenario_name)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::dollar_format(prefix = "EUR ")) +
    labs(x = "EVPPI", y = NULL, fill = "Scenario") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
             label = "Scenario EVPPI cache not available", size = 5) +
    theme_void()
}
```
